data: What is the approximate maximum vector norm value of any name across all years?

The question asks for the approximate maximum vector norm value of any name across all years. From the caption, we know that the names selected are Clinton, Bush, Obama, and Trump. The top graph shows the vector norm values for these names over the years 1990-2016. 

Looking at the top graph, we can see that the blue line (Clinton) reaches its peak around 5 on the y-axis. The green dashed line (Bush) also reaches a peak around 5 on the y-axis. The red dotted line (Obama) and the cyan dotted line (Trump) do not reach as high as 5 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate maximum vector norm value of any name across all years is around 5.
